short: An alliance of Greek city-states led by Athens, initially formed to fight the Persian Empire before transforming into an Athenian empire.
full:
Founded on the sacred island of Delos shortly after the Greek victories over Persia, the League's primary goal was to liberate Greek cities in Ionia and defend against further Persian aggression. Members contributed either ships or financial tribute (phoros) to a common treasury, with Athens providing the bulk of the naval forces and executive leadership.

Over time, Athens increasingly used the League to enforce its own hegemony. When the treasury was moved from Delos to Athens in 454 BCE, the alliance effectively became the Athenian Empire. Discontent over tribute and Athenian high-handedness alienated many members, directly contributing to the outbreak of the Peloponnesian War, which eventually saw the League dissolved upon Athens' defeat.
